body.name: Wald_G
body.def: If \(\min_j|Q_{F,j}(\operatorname{vech}\widehat\Sigma)|=0\) or \(\widehat V_F\) is singular, define \(\mathcal W_{G,N}(1-\gamma)=\mathbb R^r\). Otherwise define \(\mathcal W_{G,N}(1-\gamma)=\{t\in\mathbb R^r:N(\widehat\theta_G-t)^{\mathsf T}\widehat V_F^{-1}(\widehat\theta_G-t)\le\chi^2_{r,1-\gamma}\}\).
